targetText: Of the circuits I and II, the former is of service in a study primarily of the influence of the turnover on the formation of surplus-value and the latter in a study of its influence on the creation of the product.
explanation: The circuit of capital describes how value transforms from money capital into productive assets (machinery/labor) and commodity capital, returning as expanded money capital.

targetText: Part II: The Turnover of Capital Chapter 7: The Turnover Time and the Number of Turnovers We have seen that the entire time of turnover of a given capital is equal to the sum of its time of circulation and its time of production.
explanation: Capital turnover time consists of production time plus circulation time; reducing turnover time accelerates the annual rate of profit accumulation.

targetText: We have seen previously: "If production be capitalistic in form, so, too, will be reproduction.
explanation: Social reproduction requires continuous exchange between Department I and Department II to balance industrial equipment needs with consumer wage goods.
